year_display.zh: 约公元前 200 年至公元 200 年，传统说法

review.en: A vast compilation on theatre, covering stage building, dance, gesture, music, metre, costume and the training of actors, said to have been given by the gods as a fifth Veda. Its short account of rasa, the flavours an audience tastes through feeling, grew under later commentators into the central idea of Indian aesthetics.
review.zh: 一部关于戏剧的庞大汇编，涉及剧场营建、舞蹈、手势、音乐、格律、服饰和演员训练，相传由天神授予，号称第五吠陀。书中关于“味”（rasa）的简短论述，即观众经由情感所品尝的滋味，经后世注家阐发，成为印度美学的核心观念。
